overview: ORLA Infinity pairs a small collection of duplex homes with Foster + Partners architecture and YODEZEEN interiors. The developer describes management by Dorchester Collection.
Residents are offered access to ORLA leisure facilities. Housekeeping and other à la carte services should be checked separately from the standard management package.
research.locationNote: On the Palm Jumeirah crescent. The current developer page states a 29,000 sq m beachfront plot; its dedicated microsite and branded brochure state 16,600 sq m. The precise project boundary needs confirmation.
research.priceNote: The dedicated microsite displays AED 66m. This is a marketing reference, not a confirmed available home. Property Finder now displays AED 73m at the headline and AED 72,344,755 in its FAQ, while marking developer stock sold out and showing resales. Obtain a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Primary microsite schedule: 5% booking, 65% across SPA and subsequent instalments, 30% completion. Timings run from the SPA effective date; confirm the applicable contract and fees.
research.handoverNote: OMNIYAT gives 2027, without a quarter. Property Finder gives Q4/December 2027 but its FAQ says December 2026. The inconsistent FAQ is not adopted. No primary completion certificate or current construction percentage was retrieved.
